page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at a baseline frequency of 2.5 GHz. With a 1:1 ratio of vCPUs to physical cores, the instance provides dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading.

The hardware configuration includes 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps.

This resource density represents a standard general-purpose profile, offering a balance between compute capacity and memory allocation. It is suitable for workloads such as enterprise applications, web serving, database hosting, and medium-scale data processing that require dedicated CPU allocation and stable network throughput without the need for local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
